high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from CNN, displayed on a mobile device. The time at the top of the screen shows 6:30, with the battery level and signal strength indicators also visible. The article discusses the US Air Force B-2 Spirit bomber, which is described as one of the most expensive and sophisticated bombers in use. However, it highlights a humorous and somewhat embarrassing aspect of the aircraft's design: the toilet situation was primitive.
